Fetch the result of a finished task

Source: R/status.R
doclr_task_result.Rd

Calls GET /v1/result/{task_id}. The task must have reached the success state; ask doclr_task_status() first, or let doclr_convert() do the waiting for you.

Usage

doclr_task_result(task, client = doclr_client())

Arguments

task

A doclr_task object, or a task id string.

client

A doclr_client(). Only used when task is an id string.

Value

A doclr_document object, or a list of them.

Examples

if (FALSE) {
doclr_task_result(task)
}
